content_units: Vancouver Family Stay Snapshot
Trip:   2026-08-12 to 2026-08-16   for   2 adults + 1 child (age 7)  , so this is a   4-night stay  .
Your priorities in order appear to be:   stay under CAD 1,400 before taxes  ,   two-bed room  ,   walkable sightseeing  ,   good breakfast value  , and   minimal transit complexity  .
Hotel Fit Comparison
Option   Area   Room Setup   Breakfast   4-Night Cost Before Tax   Walkability / Transit   Budget Fit
A   Downtown Vancouver   2 queen beds   Included     CAD 1,260     High walk score; easiest for sightseeing     Yes
B   Broadway–City Hall   2 queen beds   Extra CAD 18/adult/day     CAD 1,124   base +   CAD 144   breakfast =   CAD 1,268     12 min transit to downtown; slightly more complexity     Yes
C   Near Stanley Park   1 king + sofa bed   Included     CAD 1,420     Excellent sightseeing location; low transit need     No
Best Choice for Your Family
Option A is the best fit overall.
-   Fits the budget   at   CAD 1,260 before taxes
-   Meets the room requirement best   with   2 queen beds
-   Breakfast included   gives better daily value and less planning hassle
-   Downtown location   is the simplest for a family wanting to walk to major sights with minimal transit
This option hits all of your major constraints without compromise.
Tradeoffs by Option
Option 1:   Option A — Best overall match     Strong balance of budget, beds, breakfast, and walkability     Best for easiest family sightseeing
Map Downtown
Option 2:   Option B — Best lower nightly rate     Still under budget, but breakfast charges erase most savings     Requires daily transit
View Area
Option 3:   Option C — Best location, weakest budget fit     Great area for leisure walking, but over budget and not true two-bed setup     CAD 20 over budget before taxes
Explore Stanley Park
Budget and Comfort Notes
Option A
- Total before tax:   CAD 1,260
- Leaves about   CAD 140   of room under your stated cap
- Best match if you want to keep the trip simple and walk-heavy
Option B
- Room total:   CAD 980
- Breakfast total for 2 adults over 4 mornings:   CAD 144
- Final total before tax:   CAD 1,124 + 144 = CAD 1,268
- Savings versus A are only about   CAD  -8?   No — compared correctly, B is   CAD 8 more   than A once breakfast is added? Let’s check:
- So B is actually   CAD 136 cheaper than A
- Main tradeoff: you save money, but lose the convenience of being fully walkable to central sights
Option C
- Total before tax:   CAD 1,420
- Exceeds your cap by   CAD 20
- Also less ideal than A/B if you specifically want   two actual beds  , since   1 king + sofa bed   is usually a weaker family sleep setup
Booking Decision
If your goal is the   best overall fit  , choose   Option A  .
If your goal shifts to   lowest cost while still acceptable  , choose   Option B  .
I would only choose   Option C   if you are willing to break the budget slightly and are comfortable with the   sofa bed   arrangement.
